race.title: BWB Consulting - Women In Engineering Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: MAY CALL YOU BACK can enhance her good strike rate since joining Willie Mullins. A decent record when fresh suggests Golan Loop may bounce back to form after a breathing operation and provide the main threat. MAY CALL YOU BACK GOLAN LOOP (IRE) BALLYKINLAR (IRE)
